heading: Compiled, never parsed at runtime
text:
### Compiled, never parsed at runtime [LTSL.1.2]

The DS compiler — the only parser in the system — reads a `.dstest` and lowers it
to the `Test*` (scenario) and `Oracle*` (oracle) test-atom families ([RLOW.17.1], [RDSC.7.1]).
The runtime must not parse test source; the test-mode interpreter executes the
lowered atoms ([RTIM]), as it interprets every other atom family.
